title: Super strong smell- too much fragrance!
text:
Super strong smell- too much fragrance!. This is very cute for a sea themed kind of potpourri.
It has shells and starfish, as well as other sea looking flora. I would have kept it, but the fragrance was way too much and overwhelmed the
room. I had to return it.
